_comment: Non-copyrighted preservation manifest and bounded findings for the five-row Phase-4 plant/power batch; frame boundaries are not exact writer evidence.
bounded_conclusions: All nine relevant capsules reconstruct under the exact pinned reader without a record-count or domain-hash error.
The four bytes at 0x800A6590 are retained as an unsigned low status halfword plus an adjacent raw signed halfword; this batch does not merge them into one semantic flags value.
Five A13 movies retain typed plant slot/cursor transitions and two selector-matrix variants; table residency is qualified by fixture/runtime state.
B07 retains one health increment, B08 retains two health decrements, and B09 retains paired status-0/status-32 jump episodes.
Frame-boundary correlation does not attribute an exact CPU writer, plant/power owner, attack source, DMA/GPU/SPU producer or causal control.

A13_cycle_plant_output.bounded_observation: Typed slot creation/retirement and cursor boundaries are reconstructed for all five retained A13 movies. Selector contents have more than one pristine-control-matched runtime variant, so the resident address is not treated as one immutable cross-fixture table.

B06_invincibility.bounded_observation: Health remains 4 while the decoded low status halfword and the adjacent raw signed halfword traverse several intervals; no retained boundary identifies an attack source, invincibility owner, timer writer or denial control.

B07_health_power.bounded_observation: Health changes from 3 to 4 at one retained boundary inside a broader low-status interval; same-frame evidence does not identify the health-power owner.

B08_bubble_shield.bounded_observation: Two retained health-decrement boundaries coincide with low-status/auxiliary transitions; the capsule does not establish bubble ownership, absorption, attack ownership or a counterfactual protection control.

B09_super_jump.bounded_observation: One movie contains two grounded-to-airborne episodes. The episode under low status 32 has a more-negative retained takeoff velocity and apex than the status-0 episode; frame boundaries do not identify the enabling writer.
